name: Cart bar
description: The employee app's cart bar: a green pill fixed above the tab bar, with up to three overlapping item photos, "View cart", the item count and total, and a chevron. A button stretched invisibly over the whole pill opens the Cart.

summary.description: The item count and total, such as "3 items · ₹95".

image1.description: The photo of the first item in the cart. Leave it out when the cart has no item.

image2.description: The photo of the second item. Leave it out when the cart has fewer than two items.

image3.description: The photo of the third item. Leave it out when the cart has fewer than three items.

children.description: The button that opens the Cart: a Button of the link variant labeled "View cart". It is stretched invisibly over the whole pill.
